info.title: Global Cash Management
info.description: The Global Cash Management API allows you to manage your recipient contacts, delivery channels, and delivery methods.

get.description: Get a list of recipient contacts for the account.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Limit of how many recipient contacts to return

parameters.name: AccountStatus
parameters.description: If the account status is active or not

parameters.name: ClientAccountID
parameters.description: The client account ID that the recipients belong to

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

ContactClientType.description: If the contact is a individual or business

RecipientContactID.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

FirstName.description: The first name of the recipient contact

LastName.description: The last name of the recipient contact

BusinessName.description: The business name of the recipient contact

EmailAddress.description: The email address of the recipient contact

PhoneNumber.description: The phone number of the recipient contact

IsFavorite.description: If the recipient contact is a favorite

Address.description: The address of the recipient contact

PostalCode.description: The postal code of the address

post.description: Add a recipient contact. All name, address, and phone fields must comply with Mastercard Cross-Border Services Data Quality Standards (effective April 20, 2026).

EmailAddress.description: The email address of the recipient contact

ContactClientType.description: If the contact is an individual or business

ClientAccountID.description: The client account ID the recipient belongs to

RecipientContactID.description: The ID for the recipient contact

BusinessName.description: Full legal business name of the recipient. Required if FirstName and LastName are not provided. Must be 2-60 characters and contain at least one letter. No abbreviations except standard suffixes (e.g. LLC, Ltd.).

FirstName.description: First name of the individual recipient. Required if BusinessName is not provided. Must be 2-60 characters using only letters, spaces, commas, apostrophes, hyphens, and dots. No initials, acronyms, or company identifiers.

LastName.description: Last name of the individual recipient. Required if BusinessName is not provided. Must be 2-60 characters using only letters, spaces, commas, apostrophes, hyphens, and dots. No initials, acronyms, or company identifiers.

PhoneNumber.description: Phone number of the recipient. Digits only, 9-15 characters. No spaces or hyphens (e.g. 19998887777).

Address1.description: Street address of the recipient. Must include a street name (e.g. 20 Longleat Drive). Numbers only are not accepted.

Address2.description: The second address line of the recipient contact

PostalCode.description: The postal code of the address

Country.description: Country of the recipient's address. Accepts full country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code. Sanctioned countries are not accepted.

DateOfBirth.description: Date of birth of the recipient in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 1990-01-31).

Nationality.description: The nationality specified using full country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code.

SourceOfIncome.description: The source of income of the recipient contact

Occupation.description: The occupation of the recipient contact

RelationshipWithBeneficiary.description: The sender's relationship to the recipient contact

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

RecipientContactID.description: The unique ID of the new recipient contact.

post.description: Generate a link to the cross-border iframe for onboarding recipient contacts.

ContactClientType.description: Type of contact client. Options are individual or business.

ClientAccountID.description: Client account ID. If not provided, the primary client account will be used.

ContactID.description: Contact ID. If not provided, the primary client account will be used.

FirstName.description: Client's first name. Required if BusinessName is not provided.

LastName.description: Client's last name. Required if BusinessName is not provided.

BusinessName.description: Client's business name. Required if FirstName and LastName are not provided.

SendEmail.description: Set to true to send an onboarding link via email. Default is false.

ReceiverEmailAddress.description: Recipient's email address. Required if SendEmail = true.

SendSMS.description: Set to true to send an onboarding link via SMS. Default is false.

ReceiverPhoneNumber.description: Recipient's phone number. Required if SendSMS = true.

Label.description: Label to be added to the client account. If the label doesn't exist, it will be created and applied.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

OnboardingLink.description: The URL of the onboarding link.
